newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ciampi says EMU pact deal "virtually reached".
newsitem.headline: Ciampi says EMU pact deal "virtually reached".

text.p: Italian finance minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Friday the EU had made great progress on a pact to enforce fiscal discipline under monetary union.

"The accord has been virtually reached," Ciampi told reporters in Dublin, where finance ministers worked until early Friday morning to try to thrash out a compromise. "We are satisfied that great progress has been made."

The finance ministers also discussed a proposal from the European Commission for legislation to settle technical and legal questions over the introduction of the euro single currency, set for January 1, 1999.
Ciampi said, "We have reached an accord on various legal aspects of the euro." Asked for details, he said, "You will see them later today."

EU leaders were due start a two-day summit at 1000 GMT on Friday. Thursday's special session of finance ministers was aimed at filling in details of the stability pact on fiscal discipline after economic and monetary union (EMU), ready for the leaders to discuss it.
